notes.title: Get Ready for Weapons Arena at Steam's Eastern Game Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello gamers! Weapons Arena will soon be participating in Steam's Eastern Game Fest! Come join the event and get an awesome gaming experience.During the event, you can experience the trial version in steam! If you like the game, please add it to your wishlist!

Event Period: From 10:00, Apr. 23, 2025 to 10:00, May. 2, 2025 (PT)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172844/15f6ead235bc0d5adb87d6b284a9cc9c89deaf39.jpg[/img]

Weapons Arena is a top-down turn-based strategy game. You'll be controlling a gun against a wide variety of cold weapons with a variety of attacks, and all you have to do is aim at effective range and pull the trigger. Will you be able to keep your gun fast and accurate while the enemy keeps you on your toes? Now try it out!

notes.title: The new version of "Weapons Arena" is launched during the Next Fest！
notes.notes:
Dear friends, it’s been just over half a month since the last offline expo demo, and now a brand-new version of the free online demo is about to launch!

Currently, in the Weapons Arena free demo, you can experience three types of weapons and two main levels. We welcome both new and returning friends to try it out. Additionally, we will be actively gathering your feedback and suggestions across various community platforms.

Guys, head over to the Weapons Arena Demo Steam page and download the demo now!
Demo page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3211940/

Tips：
1.This demo content is still undergoing continuous adjustments, and you may encounter various strange bugs during the game trial. We appreciate your understanding!
2.We welcome everyone to join our Discord (https://discord.gg/dYZp8Ekj2X) to provide us with feedback and suggestions at any time. We will do our best to fix issues and optimize the experience!

Looking forward to your experience!

notes.title: DEMO-v0.2
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing the demo of Sword and Blade Arena! Based on player feedback, we have optimized the following aspects. More content is in development, and we welcome you to add the game to your wishlist to stay updated on the progress.

[list][h3][b][New Weapon] [/b][/h3] [*] New unlockable weapon for players—Is it a Glock? [/list]

[list][h3][b][Optimizations] [/b][/h3] [*] Optimized UI interface [*] Added attack range display for players [/list]

[list][h3][b][Bug Fixes] [/b][/h3] [*] Fixed shotgun range issue [*] Fixed issue where players do not die after falling [*] Fixed issue where players gain shields unnecessarily [/list]

[list][h3][b]About Save Files[/b][/h3] [*] This version will overwrite previous save files. We apologize for the inconvenience! We've updated the save system, and future updates will no longer overwrite saves. [/list]

notes.title: Weapons Arena free demo officially launched on October 8th!
notes.notes:
Dear friends, it’s been just over half a month since the last offline expo demo, and now a brand-new version of the free online demo is about to launch!

Currently, the Weapons Arena free demo has officially launched its first online trial on October 8th at 7:00 PM PT! You can experience two types of weapons and two main levels. We welcome both new and returning friends to try it out. Additionally, we will be actively gathering your feedback and suggestions across various community platforms.

Guys, head over to the Weapons Arena Demo Steam page and download the demo now!
Demo page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3211940/

Tips：
1.This demo content is still undergoing continuous adjustments, and you may encounter various strange bugs during the game trial. We appreciate your understanding!
2.We welcome everyone to join our Discord (https://discord.gg/dYZp8Ekj2X) to provide us with feedback and suggestions at any time. We will do our best to fix issues and optimize the experience!

Looking forward to your experience!

notes.title: The trip to the Tokyo Game Show is about to come to a successful end!
notes.notes:
